content: We have all needed data: test set evaluation metrics from train_xgboost_model result includes mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance. Cross-validation results include r2_mean and r2_std. Need to save results as JSON file with keys test_set_evaluation and cross_validation_results. Should include mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance under test_set_evaluation. And cross_validation_results with r2_mean and r2_std. Let's construct JSON and write to file path maybe results.json in same directory. Use write_file tool.
